name: smwmusic-naruto-artificial-intelligence-bomb
title: NARUTO - Artificial Intelligence Bomb
description: "aibomb" is a famous NES chiptune song that was written for the Famicompo contest by NARUTO in 2003. It got 2nd place: https://nesmusic.zophar.net/results.html. It is cherished by many chiptune artists and has been remixed to death. It has also since been used in various YTPMVs. It is quite an upbeat song that consists of 7 sections of bleeps and bloops.
